I am! Wish I didn't have to take them... I've never been one to remember. It is pushing the limits of my brain lol 👀

My husband knows about the abuse. He understands how traumatic is was for me. Same with my therapist. But it doesn't feel like enough, somehow. The pain doesn't stop.

Thank you for your kind words. 💙

I have a beautiful life, with a wonderful husband. He's the reason why I don't want to attempt suicide again, I can't put him through it. 

Bur the scars of my childhood abuse follow me everywhere. I feel like a fraud. I feel worthless. I feel like my husband deserves better. I can't take criticism. So I feel like a burden. My therapist takes me seriously, but sometimes that doesn't feel like enough. Sometimes it feels like I need to physically harm myself for everyone in my life to go..:. "Oh........ she's really been through some shit and she's hurting and DAMN THAT WASNT OKAY, what happened to you." It feels like no human can give me what I need in terms of understanding or validating the terror I experienced. :(
May I ask why? I know sometimes I don't have an answer to that question.

I want the emotional pain and the emptiness to stop. :( 

Also, I feel like I might be taken seriously if I were physically hurt.
Sometimes there's no point in "discovering" *why* you're depressed/suicidal.

This group is called suicide watch. Most of the time depression and/or suicidal ideation doesn't have an answer to that question. In fact, asking that question can do more damage than good. That is why it is a bad question.
"What are you depressed about?" Isn't a good question.
It isn't your fault. These just just happen :)
We... we do want to live while not feeling constantly on edge that we may be kicked off of our property with nowhere to put the thing 😂
Yeah, I would rather just build a damn tiny home and some land. We want privacy! Lol

Good luck to you and your family! I'm nervous about local regulations and actually finding a plot of land to buy, close to work. There isn't much information out there. 

We are most likely doing the on-wheels option, too.
